# The version of every migration that production has run, one per line,
# oldest first. Production runs the migrations in db/migrate/ at the
# commit it was deployed from, so after each deploy that runs migrations,
# replace this list with the versions at that commit:
#
#   git ls-tree --name-only <deployed commit> db/migrate/ | sed -E 's|.*/([0-9]+)_.*|\1|'
#
# keeping these comment lines. The last version here is production's
# newest migration: spec/simplecov_profile.rb reads it as
# PRODUCTION_SCHEMA_VERSION, so the coverage count moves with this list.
# spec/db/production_migrations_spec.rb fails when a file in db/migrate/
# is dated at or before that version but is not on this list: production
# never ran it, so it must be dated after.
